title: fix(ci): install docs validator dependencies for Media deployment
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The Media production deployment job now runs root `npm ci` instead of installing only the `shared` workspace, while retaining Media’s separate install. This supplies dependencies such as `ajv` to the Gen request-example validator used by Media’s docs test, which had blocked the Media and Gen deployment pipeline.
